sv.title: Arctic mäklar storpost i Sveafastigheter
sv.summary: En post motsvarande 1,6 procent av aktiekapitalet i fastighetsföretaget Sveafastigheter anmäldes på onsdagsförmiddagen internmäklad av investmentbanken Arctic Securities.

en.title: Arctic brokers large block of Sveafastigheter
en.summary: A block equivalent to 1.6 percent of the share capital of property company Sveafastigheter was reported internally brokered by investment bank Arctic Securities on Wednesday morning.
